title: Quickly Baked Croatian Pumpkin Casserole
description: A cultured, cheese-pull, meal-prep Croatian dish featuring pumpkin and bonito-shave, friendly for those who avoid onion and garlic.

ingredients.name: pumpkin puree
ingredients.notes: canned or fresh, cooked and mashed

ingredients.name: grated cheese
ingredients.notes: a mix of cheddar and mozzarella

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine pumpkin puree, grated cheese, bonito flakes, eggs, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Grease a bento box or a small baking dish with olive oil.
Pour the pumpkin mixture into the prepared bento box or baking dish.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with additional bonito flakes if desired.
